stageSecretReferences: Operator supplies actual protected stage Secret ARNs/JSON fields; no plaintext environment/override or secret output. Existing execution role must already read those references; inability is a blocker, never expand IAM. Remove every production reference for these four names before registration.
preserveProviderSecrets: Only exact currently reviewed provider secret versions and matching PROVIDER_CONNECTIONS_JSON, under existing processing/retention eligibility. No new provider/key/region or rights inferred.
accountPreflight: Actual stage signIn/getUser UUID matches active worker_tokens.execution_account_user_id
Dedicated account has no tenant membership
Candidate runtime schema and method pins boot verified

launch.mode: one-off Fargate run-task; no update-service or new ECS service
launch.network: Actual subnet/securityGroup configuration read from existing service, not fabricated
launch.startupGate: No task launch before real preview forward authority9checks passes
launch.queue: Global stage queue; inspect current pending/leased metadata and avoid competing runtime. Do not modify the three old expired leased fixture jobs.

cleanup: Record own task ARN/start/deadline with protected metadata before launch; operator sets external 60-minute stop deadline independent of worker.
Send stop-task to this exact task only; await STOPPED and verify no further claims/outbox polls from its credential.
Revoke only a NEW dedicated evaluation worker credential/account when task has stopped. An existing credential is not automatically revoked or rotated.
Remove/revoke only newly created stage secret versions/references according to existing retention; never delete shared provider secrets.
Deregister only the new evaluation task-definition revision; no production family/service mutation.
Preserve proof/task/image digest metadata; delete only this evaluation ECR tag after proof archived and task stopped.
Retire temporary audit branch/workflow after image/task evidence; never merge it into main.
